title: Pfizer Inc Stock Price Drops Amid Global Economic Uncertainty
summary: Pfizer Inc's stock price has dropped amid global economic uncertainty, with the company's shares declining on major exchanges worldwide. The decline is attributed to concerns over inflation and interest rates. Pfizer Inc is a multinational pharmaceutical corporation based in New York, USA.
summary_points: Pfizer Inc's stock price has declined globally
The decline is attributed to economic uncertainty
Pfizer Inc is a multinational pharmaceutical corporation
The company's shares are traded on major exchanges worldwide
Global economic conditions are affecting the stock market
